description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relation  and Sabaragamuwa Development - Appoint Mr. T. Piyasoma at the arbitrator of the settlement of Industrial dispute between Free Trade Zone & General Services Employees Union Col. 10 and ATG Ceylon (Pvt.) Ltd. Katunayaka - appoint N. Bedigama at the arbitrator of the Settlement of Industrial dispute between H. K. Nimal R. G. 4, Moratuwa and State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka Col. 02
reasoning: This gazette content primarily consists of orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and exercises powers vested by that legislation. While it mentions a Minister's name and title, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function of the document, which is to formally establish arbitration proceedings under statutory authority. The core content is regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
